<!-- pr-reviewer: ad200e2c5a15627a49c384134bf9262b4d90629a -->
Needs changes before merge.

The reference covers all 44 operation kinds. Each picture has descriptive alternative text. The decision record explains the schematic format and its source.

Local results against upstream/main dc44993fc93c3fc5128fb53b34822fc3e0970d8b:
- The trial merge reports that the branch already contains main.
- `python3 site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`: 2 tests pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: zero Rust steps selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passes with zero selected steps.
- Zola 0.23.6 builds 43 pages and 4 sections successfully.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passes.
- A check of the generated HTML finds 44 image URLs outside the deployed site prefix.

Requested before merge:
1. `site/content/guide/operations-2d.md:41`: Make the image URLs respect the configured site base URL. Apply this fix to all seven changed reference pages. Zola preserves `/operation-paths.svg#Face` in the generated HTML. With `base_url = "https://neotech.github.io/Camcraft"`, the browser requests `https://neotech.github.io/operation-paths.svg#Face`. The deployed asset belongs under `/Camcraft/operation-paths.svg`. All 44 new images have this problem. Use a base-aware image URL or a suitable relative URL. Add a check of the generated URLs for a site deployed under a path. The current Python test requires the broken root-relative URL.

No machining code, geometry, stock simulation, collision checks, posted output, or goldens change. Safety-tier mutations do not apply. No `crates/ui` file changes, so the UI screenshot requirement does not apply. Rust crate builds and clippy do not apply to this documentation change. Browser rendering and external link checks were not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The requested image URL fix is complete.

- All 44 image URLs in the seven reference pages now preserve the site deployment prefix.
- `test_generated_picture_urls_preserve_site_prefix` builds the site with a `/Camcraft/` base URL. It checks all 44 generated image URLs.
- Mutation check: the original URLs fail the test. The corrected URLs pass.
- All three Python tests pass. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes with zero Rust steps. No Rust crates changed, so clippy does not apply.

New head: `695130591c820d61bec3dbc891c9388a30fa6fba`.

Please review the changes again.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 695130591c820d61bec3dbc891c9388a30fa6fba -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The new head corrects the image URL defect from the previous review. All 44 generated image URLs preserve the deployment prefix. The reference covers all current operation kinds. Each picture has descriptive alternative text. The decision record gives the source and explains the schematic format.

Local results against upstream/main dc44993fc93c3fc5128fb53b34822fc3e0970d8b:
- The trial merge reports that the branch already contains main.
- `ZOLA=/tmp/zola python3 site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`: all 3 tests pass. The URL test builds the site with Zola 0.23.6.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: zero Rust steps selected.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passes with zero selected steps.
- `git diff --check upstream/main`: passes.

I ran two mutations in a temporary copy. The PR files stayed unchanged:
- Restore the root-relative image URLs: the generated URL test fails for all seven families. Restore the corrected URLs: the test passes.
- Shift the Contour view origin by one unit: the SVG test fails. Restore the origin: the test passes.

Requested before merge: none.

No posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, geometry, or goldens change. This is not a safety-tier change. No crates/ui files change, so the UI screenshot requirement does not apply. Rust crate builds and clippy do not apply to this documentation change. Browser rendering and external link checks were not run.

Note: the PR body still describes the earlier two-test result and says that Zola did not run. This review records the current local results.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
Follow-up process fix filed as #1828: /merge-ready must not offer a PR whose only review marker is the author's own.

**Retro review (merged): clean, one follow-up filed (#1832).** What I read: the merge commit diff `31a4bab97^1..31a4bab97` in full (10 files, +534/-9), the `OpType` enum in `crates/app/src/operation/types/sel.rs` at the merge commit and on current main, `site/config.toml`, `site/README.md`, and the workflow files. Diff stat: all 10 files are docs. Seven guide pages under `site/content/guide/`, one SVG asset `site/static/operation-paths.svg`, one decision record, one Python test. No Rust file, so no build ran. Checks: - (a) Assets and links: the SVG exists and Zola serves it at the site root. All 44 references use `../../operation-paths.svg#` from a page at `/guide/operations-/`, so the URL lands on the asset under the `/Camcraft/` prefix. I ran the two non-Zola arms of `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py` at the merge commit and again against current `main` (with `python -I`): both green. The enum still has the same 44 kinds; the Zola arm could not run here (no zola binary), as the PR body already stated. - (b) Clean-room: no vendor string appears in the added lines. The diagrams are simple original primitives with a provenance comment at `site/static/operation-paths.svg:2`. The decision record says the pictures come from CamCraft's own descriptions and general machining knowledge. No image is adapted from vendor material. - (c) Provenance: the SVG and the test file carry provenance lines (`site/tests/test_operation_reference.py:3`). The legend on each family page states the pictures are illustrations without scale, not generated paths. That covers the behavior claim. - (d) Cross-references: the `[Sinker EDM](#sinker-edm)` link still resolves (`site/content/guide/operations-edm.md:9` -> heading at line 162). The EDM paragraph reflow changed no link. Every fragment id in the pages matches a `` in the SVG. Concerns (no blocker): 1. Nothing runs the new Python test. No gate tier and no workflow calls `site/tests/test_operation_reference.py`; only a `zola build` runs at the cut. A later `OpType` change can drop its picture without a red signal. Filed as #1832 (P7, effort:low). 2. The PR's open item "browser rendering still needs a check" is not closed by this review (I ran no browser). Public support tables show the `` pattern works in current Chrome, Firefox and Safari, and the root SVG sets width and height, so risk is low. A human look at the deployed page after the next cut closes it. 3. Style nits only: the commit type `fix(docs)` reads better as `docs` for a docs-only change, and a docs-only PR needs no `Changelog:` row. Neither affects the version bump. Tokens: ~38k. Tool calls: 17. Minutes: ~12.
